job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a San Francisco retirement system RFP for investment consulting services, not the external audit RFP Q&A. It does not state the total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: Request for Proposals for General Investment Consulting Services for the City and County of San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System
By this RFP, SFERS is soliciting proposals from qualified professional investment consulting Firms to provide comprehensive investment consulting advice and services to the Board and SFERS.
